quote: Not only did the Supreme Court cabin its holding in Guzman Chavez to the finality of a removal order for purposes of detention, as opposed to judicial review, but in resolving the circuit split on that issue, the Supreme Court sided with our precedent.
cite: Jose Alonso-Juarez v. Merrick Garland, 80 F.4th 1039 (9th Cir. 2023)
